description: Map source column names to harmonised concepts only when their definitions and meaning match. Update the aliases to the exact headers in the downloaded files before integration.

harmonised_features.overall_academic_score: Academic score divided by source scale maximum; available only after academic assessment
harmonised_features.latest_semester_score: Most recent grade divided by source scale maximum
harmonised_features.engagement_rate: Kaggle attendance percentage; UCI proxy is not equivalent

target_policy.preserve: Keep each original outcome string. This preserves the UCI three-class experiment (Graduate, Dropout, Enrolled) and Kaggle binary outcomes (0, 1).
target_policy.binary_dropout: Create a separate binary target. For Kaggle, 0 stays 0 and 1 stays 1. For UCI, Dropout maps to 1, Graduate to 0, and Enrolled to null (unresolved; excluded from binary dropout training to avoid incorrectly conflating active students with graduates). Never overwrite target_original.
